d:
Mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri aur prashant kishor ki mulakat men garmajoshi aur shishtachar dikha, lekin rajnitik morche par donon ke bich talkhi barakrar hai. prashant kishor ne saph kaha ki mulakat ka matlab yah nahin ki unke saval aur aarop khatm ho jaenge. aakhir mulakat men samman aur siyasat men virodh ka kya hai pura mamla? dekhie yah khas riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
